locales.title: Your first product
locales.content:
That’s huge! You’re well on your way to building a successful online store — now it’s time to think about how you’ll fulfill your orders.

Read our shipping guide to learn best practices and options for putting together your shipping strategy. And for WooCommerce stores in the United States, you can print discounted shipping labels via USPS with WooCommerce Shipping.

locales.title: Optimizing the checkout flow
locales.content: It’s crucial to get your store’s checkout as smooth as possible to avoid losing sales. Let’s take a look at how you can optimize the checkout experience for your shoppers.

locales.title: WooPayments setup - let us know what you think
locales.content: Congrats on enabling WooPayments for your store. Please share your feedback in this 2 minute survey to help us improve the setup process.

locales.title: Share your feedback on PayPal
locales.content: Share your feedback in this 2 minute survey about how we can make the process of accepting payments more useful for your store.

locales.title: Drive traffic and sales with Google
locales.content: Reach online shoppers to drive traffic and sales for your store by showcasing products across Google, for free or with ads.

locales.title: WooCommerce Subscriptions security update!
locales.content:
We recently released an important security update to WooCommerce Subscriptions. To ensure your site’s data is protected, please upgrade WooCommerce Subscriptions to version 3.0.15 or later.

Click the button below to view and update to the latest Subscriptions version, or log in to WooCommerce.com Dashboard and navigate to your Downloads page.

We recommend always using the latest version of WooCommerce Subscriptions, and other software running on your site, to ensure maximum security.

If you have any questions we are here to help — just open a ticket.

locales.title: Update to WooCommerce 5.4.1 now
locales.content: WooCommerce 5.4.1 addresses a checkout issue discovered in WooCommerce 5.4. We recommend upgrading to WooCommerce 5.4.1 as soon as possible.

locales.title: Get the latest PayPal extension for WooCommerce
locales.content:
Heads up! There’s a new PayPal on the block!

Now is a great time to upgrade to our latest PayPal extension to continue to receive support and updates with PayPal.

Get access to a full suite of PayPal payment methods, extensive currency and country coverage, and pay later options with the all-new PayPal extension for WooCommerce.

locales.title: Upgrade your PayPal experience!
locales.content:
Get access to a full suite of PayPal payment methods, extensive currency and country coverage, offer subscription and recurring payments, and the new PayPal pay later options.

Start using our latest PayPal today to continue to receive support and updates.

locales.title: Action required: Critical vulnerabilities in WooCommerce
locales.content:
In response to a critical vulnerability identified on July 13, 2021, we are working with the WordPress Plugins Team to deploy software updates to stores running WooCommerce (versions 3.3 to 5.5) and the WooCommerce Blocks feature plugin (versions 2.5 to 5.5).

Our investigation into this vulnerability is ongoing, but we wanted to let you know now about the importance of updating immediately.

For more information on which actions you should take, as well as answers to FAQs, please urgently review our blog post detailing this issue.

locales.title: Action required: Critical vulnerabilities in WooCommerce Blocks

Our investigation into this vulnerability is ongoing, but we wanted to let you know now about the importance of updating immediately.

For more information on which actions you should take, as well as answers to FAQs, please urgently review our blog post detailing this issue.

Your store has been updated to the latest secure version(s). For more information and answers to FAQs, please review our blog post detailing this issue.

locales.title: We’re all ears! Share your experience so far with WooCommerce
locales.content: We’d love your input to shape the future of WooCommerce together. Feel free to share any feedback, ideas or suggestions that you have.

locales.title: Security auto-update of WooCommerce
locales.content: Your store has been updated to the latest secure version of WooCommerce. We worked with WordPress to deploy PayPal Standard security updates for stores running WooCommerce (version 3.5 to 6.3). It’s recommended to disable PayPal Standard, and use PayPal Payments to accept PayPal.

locales.title: Security auto-update of WooCommerce
locales.content: Your store has been updated to the latest secure version of WooCommerce. We worked with WordPress to deploy security updates related to PayPal Standard payment gateway for stores running WooCommerce (version 3.5 to 6.3).

locales.title: Your Pinterest for WooCommerce plugin is out of date!
locales.content: Update to the latest version of Pinterest for WooCommerce to continue using this plugin and keep your store connected with Pinterest. To update, visit Plugins > Installed Plugins, and click on “update now” under Pinterest for WooCommerce.

locales.title: How is your store setup going?
locales.content:
Our goal is to make sure you have all the right tools to start setting up your store in the smoothest way possible.
We’d love to know if we hit our mark and how we can improve. To collect your thoughts, we made a 2-minute survey.

locales.title: كيف تسير عملية إعداد متجرك؟
locales.content:
هدفنا هو التأكد من لديك جميع الأدوات المناسبة لبدء إعداد متجرك بأسهل طريقة ممكنة.
نود معرفة ما إذا كنا قد وفقنا في تحقيق هدفنا أم لا، وكيف يمكننا التحسين. لجمع آرائك، أعددنا لك استطلاع للرأي مدته 2 دقيقة.

locales.title: 您的商店设置工作进展如何？
locales.content:
我们的目标是确保您拥有所有合适的工具，以便尽可能顺利地开始设置您的商店。
我们很想知道我们是否达到了预期目标，以及我们可以如何改进。 为了收集您的想法，我们制作了一份 2 分钟的调查问卷。

locales.title: 你的商店設定進展如何？
locales.content:
我們的目標是確保你取得所有必備工具，能夠以最順暢的方式開始設定自己的商店。
我們想知道是否達成目標，以及如何進行提升。 為了收集你的想法，我們製作了 2 分鐘的問卷調查。

locales.title: Hoe gaat het met het opzetten van je winkel?
locales.content:
Ons doel is ervoor te zorgen dat je alle juiste tools hebt om je winkel op de soepelste manier op te zetten.
We horen graag of we ons doel hebben bereikt en hoe we kunnen verbeteren. We hebben een enquête van 2 minuten gemaakt om te horen hoe het gaat.

locales.title: Comment se passe la configuration de votre boutique ?
locales.content:
Notre objectif est de nous assurer que vous avez tous les bons outils pour commencer à configurer votre boutique de la manière la plus fluide possible.
Nous aimerions savoir si nous y sommes parvenus et comment nous pouvons nous améliorer. Pour recueillir vos idées, nous avons réalisé un sondage de 2 minutes.

locales.title: Wie läuft die Einrichtung deines Shops ab?
locales.content:
Wir möchten sicherstellen, dass du alle passenden Tools hast, damit du deinen Shop so problemlos wie möglich einrichten kannst.
Wir würden gerne wissen, ob wir unser Ziel erreicht haben und wie wir uns verbessern können. Um deine Meinung zu erfahren, haben wir eine zweiminütige Befragung erstellt.

locales.title: איך הולך עם הגדרת החנות שלך?
locales.content:
המטרה שלנו היא לוודא שיהיו ברשותך כל הכלים הנכונים כדי להתחיל להקים את החנות שלך בצורה החלקה ביותר האפשרית.
נשמח לדעת אם מימשנו אותה וכיצד נוכל להשתפר. כדי לשמוע את דעתך, הכנו סקר בן 2 דקות.

locales.title: Bagaimana perkembangan penyiapan toko Anda?
locales.content:
Kami ingin memastikan Anda memiliki alat-alat yang tepat untuk mempersonalisasi toko semudah mungkin.
Kami ingin tahu apakah kami sudah tepat sasaran dan apa saja yang perlu ditingkatkan. Untuk mengetahui pendapat Anda, kami membuat survei yang pengisiannya hanya butuh waktu 2 menit.

locales.title: Come va la configurazione del negozio?
locales.content:
Il nostro obiettivo è quello di offrirti tutti gli strumenti giusti per iniziare a configurare il tuo negozio nel modo più semplice possibile.
Ci piacerebbe sapere se l'abbiamo raggiunto e come possiamo migliorare. Abbiamo creato un sondaggio di 2 minuti per conoscere la tua opinione.

locales.title: ストアのセットアップは順調に進んでいますか ?
locales.content:
適切なツールがすべて揃った状態で、できる限りスムーズにストアをセットアップしていただけることがわたしたちの目標です。
その目標を達成できているかどうか、また改善点があればぜひお聞かせください。 ご意見をお伺いする場として、2分間のアンケートを用意しています。

locales.title: 스토어 설정은 잘 진행되고 있나요?
locales.content:
가능한 가장 원활하게 스토어 설정을 시작할 수 있도록 모든 적합한 도구를 제공하는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.
목표를 달성했는지, 그리고 어떻게 개선할 수 있는지 알고 싶습니다. 여러분의 의견을 듣기 위해 2분 정도 소요되는 설문조사를 준비했습니다.

locales.title: Como está indo a configuração da sua loja?
locales.content:
Nosso objetivo é garantir que você tenha todas as ferramentas certas para começar a configurar sua loja da maneira mais tranquila possível.
Adoraríamos saber se atingimos nosso objetivo e como podemos melhorar. Para saber sua opinião, criamos uma pesquisa de 2 minutos.

locales.title: Как проходит настройка магазина?
locales.content:
Наша цель — обеспечить вас всеми необходимыми инструментами, чтобы вы могли приступить к настройке магазина, избежав по возможности любых технических проблем.
Мы хотели бы знать, удалось ли нам достичь цели и что мы можем улучшить. Чтобы узнать мнение пользователей, мы создали 2-минутный опрос.

locales.title: ¿Cómo va la configuración de tu tienda?
locales.content:
Nuestro objetivo es garantizar que cuentas con las herramientas adecuadas para empezar a configurar tu tienda de la manera más fácil possible.
Nos encantaría saber si hemos cumplido nuestra objetivo y cómo podemos mejorar. Para recopilar tus opiniones, hemos creado una encuesta de 2 minutos.

locales.title: Hur går det med konfigureringen av din butik?
locales.content:
Vårt mål är att se till att du har rätt verktyg för att börja konfigurera din butik på enklast möjliga sätt.
Vi vill gärna veta om vi har lyckats och hur vi kan förbättra oss. Vi har skapat en två minuter lång undersökning för att samla in dina åsikter.

locales.title: Mağaza kurulumunuz nasıl gidiyor?
locales.content:
Hedefimiz mağazanızı mümkün olan en sorunsuz şekilde kurmaya başlamanız için tüm doğru araçlara sahip olduğunuzdan emin olmak.
Hedefimizi tutturup tutturmadığımızı ve kendimizi nasıl geliştirebileceğimizi bilmek isteriz. Düşüncelerinizi öğrenmek için 2 dakikalık bir anket yaptık.

locales.label: セットアップの感想をお聞かせください
Расскажите нам, как этот процесс проходит у вас.
Berätta för oss hur det går

locales.title: Security vulnerability patched in WooCommerce Eway Gateway
locales.content:
In response to a potential vulnerability identified in WooCommerce Eway Gateway versions 3.1.0 to 3.5.0, we’ve worked to deploy security fixes and have released an updated version.
No external exploits have been detected, but we recommend you update to your latest supported version 3.1.26, 3.2.3, 3.3.1, 3.4.6, or 3.5.1

locales.title: WooCommerce Eway Gateway has been automatically updated
locales.content: Your store is now running the latest secure version of WooCommerce Eway Gateway. We worked with the WordPress Plugins team to deploy a software update to stores running WooCommerce Eway Gateway (versions 3.1.0 to 3.5.0) in response to a security vulnerability that was discovered.

locales.title: Navigating WooCommerce on WordPress.com
locales.content: We are improving the WooCommerce navigation on WordPress.com and would love your help to make it better! Please share your experience with us in this 2-minute survey.

locales.title: Action required: Security update of WooCommerce Subscriptions
locales.content: Your store requires a security update for the WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin. Please update the WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin immediately to address a potential vulnerability.

locales.title: Action required: Security update of WooCommerce Returns and Warranty Requests extension
locales.content: Your store requires a security update for the Returns and Warranty Requests extension. Please update to the latest version of the WooCommerce Returns and Warranty Requests extension immediately to address a potential vulnerability discovered on May 31.

locales.title: Action required: Security update of WooCommerce One Page Checkout
locales.content: Your shop requires a security update to address a vulnerability in the WooCommerce One Page Checkout extension. The fix for this vulnerability was released for this extension on June 13th. Please update immediately.

locales.title: Action required: Security update of WooCommerce GoCardless Extension
locales.content: Your shop requires a security update to address a vulnerability in the WooCommerce GoCardless extension. The fix for this vulnerability was released on July 4th. Please update immediately.

locales.title: Scheduled FedEx API outage — July 2023
locales.content: On July 16 there will be a full outage of the FedEx API from 04:00 to 08:00 AM UTC. Due to planned maintenance by FedEx, you'll be unable to provide FedEx shipping rates during this time. Follow the link below for more information and recommendations on how to minimize impact.

locales.title: Action required: USPS HAZMAT compliance update for WooCommerce Shipping & Tax extension
locales.content: Your store requires an update for the WooCommerce Shipping extension. Please update to the latest version of the WooCommerce Shipping & Tax extension immediately to ensure compliance with new USPS HAZMAT rules currently in effect.

locales.title: Action required: Security update for WooCommerce Stripe plugin
locales.content: Your shop requires an important security update for the WooCommerce Stripe plugin. The fix for this vulnerability was released on July 31. Please update immediately.

locales.title: Security update of WooCommerce Stripe plugin
locales.content: Your store has been updated to the latest secure version of the WooCommerce Stripe plugin. This update was released on July 31.

locales.title: Security update of WooPayments (WooCommerce Payments) plugin
locales.content: Your store has been updated to the more secure version of WooPayments (WooCommerce Payments). This update was released on July 31.

locales.title: Automatically calculate VAT in real time
locales.content: Take the effort out of determining tax rates and sell confidently across borders with automated tax management from Avalara AvaTax— including built-in VAT calculation when you sell into or across the EU and UK. Save time and stay compliant when you let Avalara do the heavy lifting.

locales.title: Your store requires a security update
locales.content: Your shop needs an update to address a vulnerability in WooCommerce. The fix was released on Sept 15. Please update WooCommerce to the latest version immediately. Read our developer update for more information.

locales.title: Action required: Security update for WooCommerce Stripe Gateway
locales.content: Your shop requires a security update to address a vulnerability in the WooCommerce Stripe Gateway. The fix for this vulnerability was released on October 17. Please update immediately.

locales.title: Enjoying Amazon MCF for WooCommerce?
locales.content: We're Never Settle, the developers behind Amazon MCF for WooCommerce, and would be deeply honored to have your review. Reviews help immensely as other users can learn how MCF can solve their needs too! Not happy or need help? Please reach out for support and we’d love to make things right!

locales.title: Estimated deposits are going away
locales.content: To provide more accurate deposit information and support the expansion of instant deposits, estimated deposit details will no longer be available in WooPayments. We recommend upgrading to the latest version of WooPayments for more detailed balance status information.

locales.title: An important update is required for WooCommerce
locales.content:
This update addresses a security vulnerability that could allow unauthorized access to administrative privileges on your site. Learn more.

Please ensure your site is updated to the latest version to stay secure.

locales.title: Update required for your PayPal Braintree extension
locales.content: To continue securely accepting payments, you must update your PayPal Braintree extension to version 3.2.4 or newer before June 30, 2025. Your current extension version will not support payment processing after this date due to an SSL certificate update.

locales.title: UK VAT numbers are no longer supported
locales.content: Due to recent HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) VAT API changes, your EU VAT Number for WooCommerce extension can no longer validate UK VAT numbers. HMRC now requires merchants to register an API key, which this extension does not currently support. We recommend EU/UK VAT Validation Manager for WooCommerce as a replacement

locales.title: Action required: Update the PayPal Braintree extension
locales.content: Your PayPal Braintree extension is using an outdated SDK and will stop processing payments after June 30, 2025, due to a root SSL certificate expiration. To avoid service disruption, update to version 3.2.4 or newer immediately.

locales.title: Learn how to build your store with WooCommerce
locales.content: In this free course, we'll help you set up and run your online store with clear, practical guidance.

locales.title: Action Required by October 12, 2026: Your products will stop showing on Google
locales.content: You need to update Google for WooCommerce to the latest version (3.9.4) to continue syncing your products to Google Merchant Center without issues. The Google for WooCommerce version you have installed uses the legacy Content API which has been deprecated and replaced by the advanced Google Merchant API.
